description: 한국전자통신연구원_음성인식 기술 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 최신 인공지능 기술에 기반하여 한국어, 영어, 다국어(일본어/중국어/독어/불어/스페인어/러시아어/베트남어/아랍어/태국어)에 대해 고성능의 음성인식 정확률을 제공하는 서비스로서, 사용자가 발성한 녹음된 입력 음성 데이터(단위 파일 또는 버퍼)를 음성인식 서버로 전달하여 문자(텍스트)로 제공합니다. 음성인식... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 음성인식, 인공지능, 음성분석, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
